entities.summary: Nicholas Andres Martinez is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Tampa Bay Rays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Texas Rangers, San Diego Padres, Cincinnati Reds, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters and Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks.
